title: Speaking — Going to a performance
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on going to a performance.

questions: What is a typical breakfast for you?
When do you usually eat your main meal?
Which meal of the day do you most look forward to?
Do you enjoy eating with several other people?
What types of live performance do you enjoy?
Do you read about an event before attending it?

part2.topic: Describe a performance that surprised you in a good way.
part2.closing: and explain why the performance proved memorable.

questions: How can venues attract people who rarely attend live events?
What role should arts education play in helping young people enjoy performances?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to going to a performance?
